verdict.rationale: Windows ships AI features such as Copilot and Paint Cocreator, so an opt-out from AI training is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The community complaints about mandatory telemetry concern a different subject and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
